_comment: Local-only SeaweedFS S3 identities for the dev stack (01.8.1-T2 mounts this file) and the 01.8.1-T1 parity tests. These static test credentials are committed on purpose because they are never accepted by anything but a local SeaweedFS container; they are not secrets and must never be reused in production (00 §5.7 S3 / 01.8.1 §8).
